info.name: NEXORA API (2 of 2)
info.description: The second half of the NEXORA walkthrough: folders 5 to 10 of 10. Run these after part 1, which stores the tokens and ids used here. Have the 'NEXORA local' environment active.

item.name: 02 Member: request a 100.00 loan (above the cap: 2 approvals)
03 Member: a second open loan is refused (409)
06 Admin: a SACCO admin never approves (403)
09 Loans officer 1: cannot approve step 2 too (403)
11 Admin: loans officer 1 also becomes a finance officer
18 Member: the loan, with its decisions
6. Loan: one approval, and a rejection
01 Member: request 20.00 (within cap and 3x savings: 1 approval)
02 Loans officer 2: a rejection without a reason (400)
03 Loans officer 2: reject with a reason

body.raw: {"step": 1, "decision": "reject", "reason": "Repaid a loan this week; apply next month."}

item.name: 04 Member: the rejected loan shows the reason

exec: pm.test("json.decisions[0].reason equals Repaid a loan this week; apply next month.", function () { pm.expect(String(_body.decisions[0].reason)).to.eql("Repaid a loan this week; apply next month."); });

item.name: 06 Admin: cannot read the audit log (403)
07 Owner: no SACCO audit log without consent (403)
8. Support access: the SACCO consents, the owner reads
01 Owner: ask to read Alpha's audit log
04 Owner: read the audit log under the grant
07 Owner: refused again after the revoke (403)
01 Owner: list owners (saves the second owner)
03 Owner: revoking the second owner would leave one (409)
10. Join a SACCO by phone (once per database)
02 Beta admin: invite a phone into Beta (shows join_code)
03 Member m1: join Beta with the code
05 Member m1: SACCO login with the PIN
06 Member m1: wrong PIN is refused
